Deploy the API server from `server/` to a managed HTTPS runtime. 2. Provision PostgreSQL and apply `server/schema.sql`. 3. Set `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `CORS_ORIGIN`, and `PORT` as deployment secrets/environment variables. 4. Configure the public MVP's API URL to the deployed HTTPS API. 5. Run registration, login, feed and marketplace integration tests. 6. Add object/media storage before accepting user uploads. 7. Add payment/payout provider only after legal, tax, fraud, refund and webhook controls are implemented. 8. Add moderation, reporting, appeals, deletion/export and audit logging before broad public exposure. 9. Add AI/ML/NLP workers behind authenticated queues, rate limits, evaluation and human escalation. 10.
